claims.statement: The current1–4byte statement applies to each Unicode scalar/code point with D800–DFFF excluded, not an entire visible multi-code-point character.

evidence.locator: RFC3629 §3 encoding table and explicit U+D800–U+DFFF prohibition

claims.scope: The corrected unit is per scalar; supplementary Han may use4bytes, and no arbitrary byte string is guaranteed valid UTF-8.

claims.statement: The current👍🏽 example is two code points, U+1F44D and U+1F3FD, each4UTF-8bytes, total8bytes.
